roles.description: The game cartridge's own save memory, whether battery-backed SRAM, EEPROM or flash.
Extra data a title stores outside its own save, as a directory.
Save storage built into the console itself, as distinct from anything removable.
The Neo Geo memory card, which an arcade cabinet and a home console both take.
The only socket, or the principal one. The default: a part with no role means this.
The Backup RAM Cart, which extends internal storage rather than replacing it. A console can carry saves in both at once.
Internal flash holding system-managed save data (Wii, 3DS), as distinct from an SD card.

prefixes.description: N64 Controller Pak slots, one per controller port.
Sides of a disk that are written separately, in the game's own order.
Memory card slots, in the console's own order.
